newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher, led by Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher, led by Telecom.

text.p: 1615 GMT - Portuguese shares ended higher, shored up by a strong rise in Portugal Telecom (PT) and the usual flurry of buying before the end of the month. Dealers expected the bullish mood to persist on Wednesday.
*PSI20 index gained 0.74 pct to close at 4,712.25 points.
*PT jumped 43 escudos to 4,028 and accounted for 38 percent of total trading volume of around 3.1 billion escudos.
*The telecoms operator is expected to announce it boosted first-half profits by 39 percent to 20.5 billion escudos when it releases its results next month.
*"The market belongs to PT. The share has been stuck in a rut for a while and now buyers are returning in anticipation of good first-half results," said one trader.
*Portucel Industrial was also well bid, ending up 15 escudos at 1,040 on volume of 169,540, helped by an upbeat outlook for the pulp sector.

*Lisbon bourse will announce the price offered by Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI) in its successful bid for state-controlled Banco de Fomento e Exterior (BFE) at 0830 GMT tomorrow. Both banks' shares have been suspended since last Thursday when the government announced BPI had won the bidding battle.
